approximation.form: piecewise-linear interpolation of SiLU at 833 uniformly spaced nodes
approximation.lower_gate_clamp: none; gate values in [-16,-10) use table indices 0..191
approximation.evaluation_order: clamp; exact power-of-two scale; exact floor/grid index; explicit RN32 difference, scale, delta, multiply, add, and final clamped-up multiply; no FMA
approximation.fma: not permitted; separate RN32 multiply and RN32 add
approximation.rounding: binary32 RN ties-to-even with gradual underflow; reject nonfinite results and unsupported host arithmetic state; subnormal intermediates supported

implementation_fail_closed.required_operations: explicit RN32 multiply followed by explicit RN32 add; no contracted FMA
implementation_fail_closed.verification: compiler IR or disassembly must show separate operations and the exact implementation/compiler identity is recorded
implementation_fail_closed.failure: refuse Candidate B qualification if flags, operation separation, or compiler identity cannot be verified

certificate.silu_second_derivative_bound: M <1 on entire [-16,10], analytic derivative/exp inequality
certificate.table_certificate: all833 nodes correctly rounded by exact/outward R1; all832 gaps certified; fixture unchanged

scope: activation-only host CPU; all inherited down-QMM admission unchanged

implementation.guard_policy: ARM64 IEEE binary32; FPCR RMode/FZ/AH/FIZ and exception-enable bits clear, FE_TONEAREST; opaque canaries; no control-state writes; before GPU init, before/after each B batch and before host reduction; fail closed unsupported
